common_target_distance_range: 200bp through 0.5 times annotated structure length for all flank widths

backgrounds.clean: exclude bins overlapping any other known annotated structure

repeat_design: two unpaired biological replicates per condition; evaluate all four cross-condition contrasts
empirical_null: Within-condition replicate absolute log2 enrichment differences; maximum per largest-context overlap group and condition, pooled across WT, HNS_mut, FIS_mut; 243 group maxima per sensitivity setting
multiple_screening: Threshold comparison against empirical repeat-noise q99 at each flank/background setting; descriptive filter, not formal FDR or family-wise error control
candidate_rule: previous criteria plus every sensitivity exceeding its own pooled empirical-noise q99 and the largest observed within-repeat group maximum
